Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be called the claimant on this one, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the car that was sideswiped.
Q: That works for the file. Can you tell me where the incident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, in the right lane heading towrad a shopping center.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I was changing lanes to the left because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, didn't see anything right
beside me, and moved over slowly.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other vheicle came up alongside me and scraped the wohle passenger side of my car. I felt the steering wheel
jerk and I had to grip it hard to keep control.
Q: Did you see the other driver's lane position before you moved?
A: Not really. They seemed to be right in my blind spot, and I didn't catch them there.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: My left wrist hurt right away, but I thought it was just a sprain. I was pretty shaken up.
Q: Did you seek medical care after the incident?
A: Yes. I went to urgent care that afternoon and they took X-rays. The doctor said the wrist was fractured and I was
put in a splint.
Q: Has the wrist treatment changed since then?
A: I'm going to an orthopedic specialist next week. They told me I may need a follow-up scan.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm trying to get back to work and I'm worried about how long this will take to heal.
